title: HashyBrown
body:
# ✨ Welcome to Hashybrown ✨ 
 A quality-of-life adventure pack built for smooth performance and easy exploring. Optimized, polished, and ready to play.

### **🏔️ Explore**

New biomes, structures, and creatures to discover, with dynamic seasons and weather to keep every world feeling alive.

### **🎮 Performance & Visuals**

Bundled with Sodium, Lithium, and ModernFix for max FPS, plus Iris shader support and immersive sound for a world that looks and feels great.

### **🛠️ Quality of Life**

No more clutter or guesswork — smart inventory sorting, fair anvils, full-map support, and instant item info baked right in.

### **🔗 Connect**

**🌐 Server IP:** 
```
mc.hashybrown.com
```
